meta.name: customer-journey-mapping-workshop
meta.description: Run a customer journey mapping workshop with adaptive questions and outputs. Use when you need to map stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for a persona and scenario.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导用户绘制客户旅程地图，发现体验痛点与机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统梳理用户触点与情绪来改善产品体验
copy.tagline_en: Guide users to map customer journeys, uncover pain points and opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically map user touchpoints and emotions to improve product experience

howto.what: 引导你分步创建客户旅程图，先收集背景信息，再依次确定角色、场景、阶段、行为/情绪和机会，最后输出带优先级的旅程地图和机会清单。
howto.when: 当你需要为某个角色和场景绘制客户旅程的阶段、行为、情绪、痛点和机会时触发，例如你说出“新客户入职”或“从试用注册到首次价值体验”等场景。

say.text: 帮我为小企业主做一份新用户入门的客户旅程图。
say.note: 系统会开始分步提问引导你完成地图。

say.text: 我想绘制从免费试用注册到第一次价值体验的买家旅程。
say.note: 系统会按步骤收集角色、场景等信息。

say.text: 为高风险流失客户的支持流程做一次旅程图工作坊。
say.note: 系统会生成相应的阶段和机会。

howto.what_en: Guides you step-by-step to create a customer journey map: first gather context, then determine persona, scenario, phases, actions/emotions, and opportunities, ending with a prioritized map and opportunity list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to map stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for a specific persona and scenario, e.g., when you say “new customer onboarding” or “from trial signup to first value.”

say_en.text: Run a journey mapping workshop for small business owner onboarding.
Map the buyer experience from trial signup to first value.
say_en.note: System will collect persona, scenario, etc.

say_en.text: Facilitate a workshop on the support journey for churn-risk customers.
